backend: cached faster-whisper base CPU int8 proxy; not GPU performance

methodology.drift: token error rate against redacted stored reference using modal normalized repeat output; not ground-truth accuracy
methodology.network: disabled via HF_HUB_OFFLINE and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE; cached model only
methodology.paired_ratio: per-sample median time without timestamps divided by median time with timestamps; aggregate median/p90 only
methodology.privacy: raw inputs and outputs process-local; no transcript, identifier, sample ID, filename, or audio persisted

prompt: application vocab prompt applied in memory; omitted from artifact
vad_effective_behavior: faster-whisper consumes max_speech_duration_s and sets it to chunk_length (30s); this matches the requested 30s cap
